page.overview:
Who is Sugar Riot?

Sugar Riot is a character from Final Fantasy XIV, introduced in the expansion Dawntrail. She is one of the competitors in the cruiserweight tier of the Ascension Arcadia Championship.

Before becoming a fighter in the Arcadion, that uses the feral soul of a pudding, Sugar Riot was a rebellious street artist who painted majority of the graffiti in True Vue in Solution Nine. Even within Arcadion, she retained her rebellious nature and artistic inspiration. She rose into a contender in the cruiserweight division.

Sugar Riot was the second opponent for the Warrior of Light in the cruiserweight tier. After the Warrior of Light won, Yaana revealed to her and Dancing Green the danger of psychonekrosis, a disease contracted by excessive use of feral souls. Both were appalled, but decided to retire, with Sugar Riot claiming to back to her roots to find new inspiration for her art.

Sugar Riot agreed to help rescue Eutrope and Neyuni, whom the president had kidnapped, alongside Honey B. Lovely, Dancing Green and Retsarra. She also joined all the fighters in defeating the president as the legendary Lindwurm, in order to obtain the cure for psychonekrosis.
